title: ContinuationTask
description: A task declared in a TaskResult's additional_tasks array. Inserted into the live DAG after the parent task completes. Same shape as a planned task: name, agent, description, needs, file_scope, outputs, success_criteria, timeout.

name.description: Task identifier. Must not collide with existing tasks in the DAG.

agent.description: Name of the agent assigned to this task. Must be declared in the workflow's agents array.

description.description: What the task does. Supports ${} interpolation from upstream outputs.

needs.description: Task names this task depends on. May reference existing DAG tasks or sibling continuation tasks in the same additional_tasks array.

file_scope.description: File/directory paths this task is allowed to modify.

outputs.description: Named outputs this task will produce.
